messages:
anya: heads up — nightly evals flagged a big uptick in repetition for the summarization prompt set (rouge down, repeat-rate up). full plot attached in the eval artifact.
ellie: saw the same in manual spot checks. multiple runs show repeated phrases around token 48-65, like the model is getting stuck on a high-prob phrase.
dave: rolled kernel change yesterday that reorders KV eviction when sequence length > 1024. PR 4532. could be related.
mohit: the new reorder avoids a memcpy in the hotpath, but I changed the cache rotation loop. small diff:
```
- for (i=0; i<n; i++) rotate_back(kv[i]);
+ for (i=n-1; i>=0; i--) rotate_back(kv[i]);
```
noticed it changes the temporal ordering of keys returned to the sampler.
anya: CI bot shows entropy drop in top-k distribution right when repeats start.
ci-bot: nightly-eval: summarization-suite v2 — baseline vs current: rouge-1: -3.4, repeat-rate: +17%, avg entropy: -0.9 nats. artifact: https://ci/redwood/nightly/187234
samir: can someone dump logits and softmax for failing run? if ordering changed, quantized softmax might underflow for some lanes.
ellie: reproduced locally with `--seq-len 2048 --kv-rotation reorder`. log snippet:
```
[48] topk probs: [0.42, 0.19, 0.11, ...]
[53] topk probs: [0.86, 0.05, 0.03, ...]  <-- suspicious spike
```
dave: if rotation exposes same cache keys early, the sampler sees inflated scores due to stale attention accumulators. I can revert the loop order to confirm.
mohit: quick test results — reverting to old order drops repeat-rate back to baseline on my machine. pushing a diagnostic flag `--kv-rotation=legacy|reorder` for canary.
anya: good. can we gate the reorder behind runtime flag and re-run nightly with both variants so we get comparative artifacts?
samir: oncall, I'll flip the flag on the dedicated nightly runners and kick off a bisect run. putting rollback on the hot path if metrics don't recover. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: created ticket INF-1729 and scheduled bisect jobs. pinging @dave for PR follow-up.
